items.question: What vast number of womb-mechanisms subjects beings to torment?
premises: The number specified is eighty-four thousand.
Beings are tormented within these mechanisms.
items.inference: Beings undergo torment within eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The specific beings experiencing torment are implied from the preceding context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
